mapper.select: SELECT log.JOB_ID jobId, log.JOB_SEQ jobSeq, log.EXEC_DATE execDate, log.EXEC_STATUS execStatus FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG log WHERE log.JOB_ID=#{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( log.EXEC_DATE =#{execDate, jdbcType=DATE} OR log.LASTEXEC_DATE=#{execDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND log.STATUS = 'E' limit 1
